effects.l1: Run/long jump: add a horizontal move up to Water yards to an action.
effects.l2: Run/long jump up to Water ×2 yards; defy gravity: run up a wall up to Water yards.
effects.l3: Run/long jump up to Water ×3; wall-run up to Water ×2; jump up or drop down Water yards with no run-up or fall damage.
effects.l4: Run/long jump up to Water ×4; wall-run up to Water ×3; jump up/drop down Water ×2 yards.

system.description: Combine a movement with another action (move-and-strike, leaps, wall-running) on solid, stable ground.
